title: Legal Entity Resolution
one_line: Resolve a company domain to its registered legal entity, company number and tax identifier.
description: Resolve a company domain to its registered legal entity, company number and tax identifier. Use when someone needs the legal name for a contract, is checking whether a company is registered, needs a VAT number, or is doing supplier due diligence.
paragraph: The trading name on a website and the registered entity that signs a contract are frequently different, and the gap is where invoicing, tax and diligence problems live. This skill resolves the domain to the register record, validates the tax identifier where it can, and states the jurisdiction rather than assuming one.

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: legal-entity-resolver 0.007 USD per domain.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
